title: Floating-Point-ALU: a bit-exact C++17 software model of an IEEE 754 binary32 ALU
description: Bit-exact software model of an IEEE 754 binary32 arithmetic unit in C++17: addition, subtraction, multiplication and division with guard/round/sticky rounding in all four IEEE rounding modes, full subnormal, infinity and NaN handling, constexpr-evaluable core, and a differential test suite (32,026,992 checks, 0 failures) against the host FPU on GCC, Clang, AppleClang and MSVC.
